provenance.invocation: Reflection: DatabaseModelCompatibilityTests.RuntimeContext(kind, PostgreSql), then DesignModel(context), then IModel.GetRelationalModel(). No existing test method or database connection invoked.
provenance.prior_validation_scope: 151 previously passed package-adoption tests, including 36 model tests; none rerun for this extraction.

direct_tenant_column_detection: TenantId or OrganizationId property/column only; related fields including OwnerTenantId, ModelAssetOwnerTenantId, Scope and nullable-tenant/global rows require Owner classification. All actual columns, property mappings and keys are included.
preparatory_findings: 307 of 317 tables with direct TenantId/OrganizationId have at least one modeled PK/AK/unique index omitting that tenant column. Per-tenant table copies would weaken these currently enforced uniqueness domains unless a separately justified design preserves them.
Examples: T_StockTransaction PK(Id) remains global despite unique(TenantId,TxnNo); Space_AiBudgetReservation PK(Id) remains global despite AK(TenantId,Id) and unique(TenantId,ProviderRequestKey).

Shared message identities remain unique(MessageId) for Outbox, unique(ConsumerName,MessageId) for Inbox, and PK(MessageId) for ERP CommandInbox. Sys_RefreshTokens unique(TokenHash) and crm_identity.ServiceToken PK(Issuer,Jti) are additional global identity domains.
Four Space tables without direct TenantId/OrganizationId instead contain OwnerTenantId and scope-related keys; absence of TenantId is not evidence that the data is public or wholly global.
Sys_Langs has nullable TenantId and unique(TenantId,LangKey) with Npgsql NullsDistinct=false; shared/global-row semantics must be preserved.

No modeled views/sequences were found. This is not a statement about live catalogs or raw migration/SQL objects. Raw SQL, writers, retention, Owner classification and recovery dependencies remain incomplete.
The inventory is future-EF preparation only; it does not activate tenant routes, mark any PGT passed or create an additional acceptance gate for the current connection component.
